svg.title: Generating by removing noise
svg.desc: Five panels from left to right: pure random noise, then progressively less noise, until a clear simple picture of a house with a sun emerges in the final panel. Arrows between panels are labelled denoise step. A prompt, a house under the sun, guides every step.
svg.text: From static to picture, one small step at a time
Prompt guides every step: "a house under the sun"
Training teaches the reverse of adding noise; generation runs that reverse many times.
Schematic; real systems use dozens to hundreds of steps on far larger images.
